# (PART) Continental Ternary Partitioning & Figures {-}

# Continental Application & Dominance Regimes (`apply_model7()`) {#application}

```{r ch8-setup, include = FALSE}
source('R/00_setup.R')
```

## Continental 3-Constituent Application Dataset (`n = 478,929`)

Once Model 7 is calibrated on the `277,382` four-variable training matchups, it requires only the three constituent concentrations ($\text{NAP}$, $\text{DOC}$, and $\text{Chl }a$) to partition non-water light attenuation. We can therefore apply Model 7 across all **`r fmt_n(nrow(get_application()))`** simultaneous 3-constituent matchups in the harmonized AquaMatch dataset (with or without a paired Secchi measurement) that lie within the empirical concentration bounds of the training set and have strictly positive $\text{NAP} > `r P$apply_min_nap`\text{ mg L}^{-1}$:

```{r application, echo = FALSE}
app <- get_application(); tr <- get_training()
tibble(set = c('4-Variable Training Dataset (Secchi + 3 LACs measured, screened)',
               'Continental 3-LAC Application Dataset (within training bounds & NAP > 0.01 mg/L)',
               '  ├── Application matchups with Measured Secchi depth',
               '  └── Application matchups with Modeled Secchi depth only (no measured Secchi)'),
       n = c(nrow(tr), nrow(app), sum(!is.na(app$secchi)), sum(is.na(app$secchi))),
       sites = c(n_distinct(tr$SiteID), n_distinct(app$SiteID),
                 n_distinct(app$SiteID[!is.na(app$secchi)]), n_distinct(app$SiteID[is.na(app$secchi)]))) %>%
  mutate(across(c(n, sites), fmt_n)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c('Dataset Subset', 'Observations (n)', 'Unique Monitoring Sites')) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c('condensed', 'striped'), full_width = FALSE)
```

For each observation $r$, the non-water light attenuation share of constituent $i \in \{\text{NAP}, \text{DOC}, \text{Chl }a\}$ and the modeled Secchi depth ($\hat{z}_{SD,r}$) are:

$$f_{i,r} = \frac{\alpha_i C_{i,r}}{\alpha_{\text{NAP}}\,\text{NAP}_r + \alpha_{\text{DOC}}\,\text{DOC}_r + \alpha_{\text{Chl }a}\,\text{Chl }a_r}, \qquad \hat{z}_{SD,r} = \frac{1}{k_w + \alpha_{\text{NAP}}\,\text{NAP}_r + \alpha_{\text{DOC}}\,\text{DOC}_r + \alpha_{\text{Chl }a}\,\text{Chl }a_r}$$

Across all **`r fmt_n(nrow(get_final_data()))`** application matchups, **`r round(100 * mean(get_final_data()$model == 'z3'), 1)`%** (`r fmt_n(sum(get_final_data()$model == 'z3'))` records) use Level III ecoregion-specific Model 7 slopes and **`r round(100 * mean(get_final_data()$model == 'global'), 1)`%** (`r fmt_n(sum(get_final_data()$model == 'global'))` records) use the global Model 1 fallback.

## Continental Mean Ternary Partitioning by Water-Body Type {#intext}

Across all **`r fmt_n(nrow(get_final_data()))`** matchups, average non-water light attenuation is led by **DOC (`58.8%`)**, followed by **NAP (`33.0%`)** and **Chl *a* (`8.2%`)**. Streams (`58.7% DOC, 34.6% NAP, 6.7% Chl a`) and estuaries (`57.1% DOC, 37.0% NAP, 5.8% Chl a`) cluster tightly along the DOC–NAP axis, whereas lakes (`60.5% DOC, 23.1% NAP, 16.5% Chl a`) exhibit more than double the phytoplankton attenuation share and span the full ternary triangle:

```{r means, echo = FALSE}
fd <- get_final_data()
bind_rows(fd %>% mutate(type = 'All Waters'), fd) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, c('All Waters', 'Stream', 'Lake', 'Estuary'))) %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), sites = n_distinct(SiteID),
             DOC = mean(doc_kd), NAP = mean(tss_kd), `Chl a` = mean(chl_kd),
             sd_DOC = sd(doc_kd), sd_NAP = sd(tss_kd), `sd_Chl a` = sd(chl_kd)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(DOC:`sd_Chl a`), ~ percent(.x, 0.1)),
         n = fmt_n(n), sites = fmt_n(sites)) %>%
  kable(col.names = c('Water-Body Type', 'Observations (n)', 'Unique Sites', 'Mean DOC %', 'Mean NAP %', 'Mean Chl a %', 'SD DOC', 'SD NAP', 'SD Chl a'),
        caption = 'Arithmetic mean and standard deviation of non-water light-attenuation fractions across the continental dataset (blue centroids in Figure 2).') %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c('condensed', 'striped'), full_width = TRUE)
```

## Water Clarity Across $>80\%$ Dominance Regimes ($p < 0.01$) {#dominance-test}

How does absolute water clarity ($z_{SD}$) vary when a single constituent dominates light attenuation? Grouping observations into four dominance regimes based on an $80\%$ threshold (**NAP-dominant** $f_{\text{NAP}} > 0.80$, **Chl *a*-dominant** $f_{\text{Chl }a} > 0.80$, **DOC-dominant** $f_{\text{DOC}} > 0.80$, and **Mixed**) reveals an important distinction between **frequency of dominance** and **severity of turbidity**:

* **DOC** is the most *frequent* single dominant attenuator (`116,567` samples, mean $z_{SD} = 1.10\text{ m}$), because background humic DOC absorbs light even in relatively clear streams and lakes when suspended sediment and algal biomass are low.
* **NAP-dominant** waters (`25,793` samples, typically storm-flow sediment plumes and erosive rivers) have the **lowest water clarity** (mean $z_{SD} = 0.40\text{ m}$, median $0.24\text{ m}$), followed by hyper-eutrophic **Chl *a*-dominant** blooms (mean $z_{SD} = 0.71\text{ m}$, median $0.38\text{ m}$), **DOC-dominant** waters ($1.10\text{ m}$), and **Mixed** waters ($1.23\text{ m}$).

```{r dom-fig, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.3, fig.cap = '(a) Proportion of samples in each >80% dominance regime by water-body type. (b) Modeled Secchi disk depth (z_SD, log scale) across the four dominance regimes; all six pairwise comparisons are significant at p < 0.01.'}
dom <- test_dominance_secchi(fd)

fd_dom <- fd %>%
  mutate(dom_class = case_when(
    tss_kd > 0.80 ~ 'NAP dominant (>80%)',
    chl_kd > 0.80 ~ 'Chl a dominant (>80%)',
    doc_kd > 0.80 ~ 'DOC dominant (>80%)',
    TRUE ~ 'Mixed (<80% each)'
  ) %>% factor(c('NAP dominant (>80%)', 'Chl a dominant (>80%)', 'DOC dominant (>80%)', 'Mixed (<80% each)')))

dom_cols <- c('NAP dominant (>80%)' = '#eab308',
              'Chl a dominant (>80%)' = '#22c55e',
              'DOC dominant (>80%)' = '#b45309',
              'Mixed (<80% each)' = '#64748b')

p_freq <- bind_rows(fd_dom %>% mutate(type = 'All Waters'), fd_dom) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, c('All Waters', 'Stream', 'Lake', 'Estuary'))) %>%
  count(type, dom_class) %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(type, pct, fill = dom_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dom_cols, name = 'Optical Regime') +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom', legend.direction = 'vertical', panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = 'Share of Matchups', title = '(a) Dominance Regime Frequency by Water Type')

p_box <- ggplot(fd_dom, aes(dom_class, secchi_pred, fill = dom_class)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, alpha = 0.88, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.05, 10), breaks = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10), labels = scales::label_number()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dom_cols) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c('NAP\n(>80%)', 'Chl a\n(>80%)', 'DOC\n(>80%)', 'Mixed\n(<80%)')) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = 'Dominance Regime', y = 'Modeled Secchi Depth z_SD (m, log scale)',
       title = '(b) Water Clarity Across Dominance Regimes')

p_freq + p_box + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1.1, 1))
```

```{r secchi-classes, echo = FALSE}
dom$summary %>%
  transmute(
    `Dominance Regime (>80%)` = class,
    `Observations (n)` = fmt_n(n_obs),
    `Unique Sites` = fmt_n(n_sites),
    `Mean Modeled Secchi (m)` = round(mean_secchi_pred, 2),
    `SD (m)` = round(sd_secchi_pred, 2),
    `Median Modeled Secchi (m)` = round(median_secchi_pred, 2),
    `Mean Combined Secchi (m)` = round(mean_secchi_combined, 2),
    `Mean Measured Secchi (m)` = round(mean_secchi_measured, 2)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = 'Secchi disk depth summary statistics across the four >80% constituent dominance regimes.') %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c('condensed', 'striped'), full_width = TRUE)
```

```{r secchi-pairwise, echo = FALSE}
dom$pairwise %>%
  transmute(
    `Pairwise Comparison` = Comparison,
    `Mean Difference (m)` = round(diff_m, 3),
    `Welch t-test p (Holm-adj.)` = format.pval(p_welch_holm, digits = 3, eps = 1e-300),
    `Wilcoxon rank-sum p (Holm-adj.)` = format.pval(p_wilcoxon_holm, digits = 3, eps = 1e-300),
    `Significant at p < 0.01?` = ifelse(pass_p01_welch & pass_p01_wilcoxon, '✔ Yes (p < 0.01)', 'No')
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = 'All 6 pairwise Secchi depth comparisons across the four dominance regimes.') %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c('condensed', 'striped'), full_width = TRUE)
```
